note: The index universe with its duplicate listings removed and every asset tagged with the class it actually belongs to. Measured over 2016-2026, the 34-ticker universe carries only 3.0 independent bets: KODEX 200, TIGER 200, KBSTAR 200, ARIRANG 200, KOSEF 200, KODEX 코스피 and KODEX 레버리지 correlate 0.975-0.998 with each other, and eleven sector ETFs correlate 0.49-0.78 with KOSPI 200 because they are pieces of it. Equal weight over that list is not a diversified portfolio; it is 59% Korean equity wearing thirty-four labels. One ticker survives from each redundant cluster, chosen for the longer history where history and liquidity disagreed, since a backtest cannot use bars that do not exist.
asset_class_note: asset_class is what an allocation rule should group by; `group` stays as the descriptive label. Sector ETFs are tagged KR_EQUITY rather than given a class of their own, because a rule that treats 'sectors' as a separate class would put 40% of the book in Korean equity while believing it put 20%.

liquidity_warning: Turnover in 2025 ranges from 4,628억원 a day (KODEX 200) to 0.2억원 (TIGER 200 금융). At a ten-million-won account every one of them is tradeable, but the 0.05% slippage the backtest assumes is optimistic for the thin ones. Closes repeat from the previous day on 0.4-5.7% of bars, which is low enough not to distort volatility or correlation estimates.
